summary: Frontend-only e2e test of the split patient/clinician portals, new doctor dashboard, cross-portal refusal, clinician access-request + admin-approval flow, and regressions on patients/schedule/encounter pages. All acceptance criteria pass.

test_results.landing_split_entry_points: PASS — login-btn, clinician-login-btn, hero-cta-btn, hero-clinician-btn all present; clinician-login-btn routes to /auth/clinician (doctor-auth-card), and cross-links switch-to-patient-auth / switch-to-doctor-auth work.
test_results.doctor_sign_in_and_dashboard: PASS — dr.layla@sihha.ai/Doctor@123 lands on /doctor showing doctor-dashboard-page, all four stat cards (stat-patients, stat-week, stat-needs-briefing, stat-awaiting-signature) and all six panels (dash-today, dash-needs-briefing, dash-awaiting-signature, dash-awaiting-intake, dash-alerts, dash-recent-runs). dash-schedule-link navigates to /doctor/schedule and dash-patients-link is present.
test_results.doctor_sidebar_clinician_only: PASS — sidebar has only nav-doctor-dashboard, nav-doctor, nav-doctor-schedule, nav-settings. nav-chat, nav-pill-id, nav-medications, nav-dependents, nav-dashboard, toggle-sharing-btn, and profile-switcher-btn are ABSENT. doctor-context-label ('Clinician workspace') is shown.
test_results.patient_side_unchanged: PASS — omar.patient@sihha.ai lands on /dashboard with nav-dashboard, nav-chat, nav-pill-id, nav-medications, nav-dependents, nav-settings, profile-switcher-btn and toggle-sharing-btn all present.
test_results.cross_portal_refusal: PASS — /auth with dr.layla creds shows auth-error 'This is a clinician account. Use the clinician sign-in instead.' and stays on /auth. /auth/clinician with omar creds shows 'This account isn't a clinician account. Use the patient sign-in instead.' and stays on /auth/clinician.
test_results.clinician_access_request: PASS — auth-tab-register on /auth/clinician submitted with a fresh email produces clinician-request-sent ('Request received'). Immediately re-signing in on /auth/clinician with the same creds is refused with the patient-account auth-error (still a patient role until approval).
test_results.admin_approval: PASS — admin@sihha.ai/Admin@123 signs in on /auth/clinician (admin has role=doctor and is redirected to /doctor). /admin/assignments shows assignment-row-{user_id} for the new applicant with an approve-clinician-{user_id} button. Clicking it (auto-accepting the confirm dialog) succeeds and the button is removed for the row.
test_results.post_approval_sign_in: PASS — the newly approved account signs in on /auth/clinician, lands on /doctor, and doctor-dashboard-page renders with stat-patients = 0.
test_results.regression_patients_schedule_encounter: PASS — /doctor/patients renders the 'My Patients' heading. /doctor/schedule loads (URL correct). /doctor/encounters/enc_fc5e6d2f320f renders the intake questionnaire (Pre-Visit Intake, 8 answered questions) and the AI Screenings section (briefing section further down was not explicitly asserted via testid but section headers render — see minor note).

critical_code_review_comments: DoctorDashboard.jsx line 86 shows 'Loading your day…' until the first /api/doctor/dashboard resolves; this can flash briefly on slow networks but is not a bug.
Auth.jsx correctly refuses cross-portal logins client-side by inspecting the user.role returned from /api/auth/login and immediately calling logout; there is no unauthenticated leak.
Layout.jsx cleanly separates patientNav vs doctorNav and hides toggle-sharing-btn / profile-switcher-btn for role=doctor. doctor-context-label is rendered instead.
test_credentials: Used seeded credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (dr.layla, omar.patient, admin). Created throwaway clinician-request account tclin1787225224@example.com / TestPass@123 (now approved to role=doctor with 0 patients).
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway clinician-request account tclin1787225224@example.com (approved). Prior test agent left 4 additional test_clin_*@example.com pending-clinician accounts visible in /admin/assignments (test_clin_de10f1e6, test_clin_1f98312e, test_clin_e9ab91f7, test_clin_909b4a0b). None have patients assigned; safe to leave or remove.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything on this iteration passed. When testing admin flows, remember admin@sihha.ai has role=doctor so it must sign in via /auth/clinician (or would be blocked by the cross-portal guard on /auth). /doctor is the new dashboard route; the old patient /dashboard route is patient-only. Test throwaway clinician tclin1787225224@example.com (password TestPass@123) is now an approved doctor with 0 patients if you need one.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no defects found in scoped features.
